test_freeze_batchnorm: test that batchnorm layer weights and biases have requires_grad set to False when batchnorm_frozen is True
test_freeze_output: test that output layer parameters have requires_grad set to False when output_frozen is True
test_freeze_others: test that non-batchnorm and non-output parameters have requires_grad set to False when others_frozen is True
test_freeze_all: test that all model parameters have requires_grad set to False when all freezing flags are enabled
test_freeze_none: test that all model parameters have requires_grad set to True when no freezing flags are enabled
